action_items: (A11y, minor) Wrap dialog headers in <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle) in TaskDetailDialog and TaskFormDialog to remove Radix console warning.

(Consistency, minor) Backend TaskUpdateInput.description uses default "" while server code does `if body.description is not None and body.description != ""` — this means you can't clear description via PUT. Consider allowing empty string to clear.
(Consistency, minor) Update endpoint validates status against [pendiente, en_proceso, completada]; ensure frontend never sends stale values like 'en_progreso' (it doesn't today, but doc it).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_task: `if body.description is not None and body.description != ''` silently drops empty-string updates, so users cannot clear description via PUT. Recommend `if body.description is not None: update_fields['description'] = body.description.strip()`.

server.py send_task_documents_email: attachments are loaded from object storage inside a BackgroundTasks handler using base64 in-memory. For large multi-doc tasks (50MB * N) this can blow memory. Consider streaming or size cap on total attachment size (Resend also has ~40MB per email limit).

server.py _send_task_documents_email_bg: reads sync_db.settings on every send; consider caching. If resend fails silently (try/except at line 3826), user still sees success toast — no error surfaced. Consider persisting a delivery status on the task.
AdminTareas.js: file is 927 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold. Consider splitting TaskCard, TaskDetailDialog, TaskFormDialog into separate files under /pages/tareas/.
AdminTareas.js dropzone (task-doc-dropzone) uploads files sequentially in a loop; for many attachments consider Promise.all with concurrency cap.
Backend allows any authenticated staff/admin to send docs of any task — no check that current user is the task creator or assignee. Consider ownership check depending on business rules.
